Cost-based pricing involves setting prices primarily by considering the costs of production and distribution, plus a desired profit margin.  
Option (A) refers to value-based pricing, (B) refers to psychological pricing, and (C) refers to feature/benefit-based pricing, which is also more aligned with value-based methods.  
Option (D) explicitly mentions "full cost of production plus the required profit," which matches the definition of cost-based pricing.  

Final answer: (D)
